summary: AN2 Therapeutics filed an ATM prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) to register up to $80M in common stock for sale via an open market sales agreement with Jefferies as agent. Shares trade at $3.61, with Jefferies receiving up to 3.0% commission. This is a routine at-the-market offering, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or other event described. The filing is a standard capital raise under an existing shelf registration statement. There are no deal terms to track; the offering is purely a financing tool.
